item.title: New York school pauses plan to deploy humanlike AI robot teacher after backlash
item.description: A New York school district halts plans for an AI-powered humanoid robot in classrooms after opposition from state officials and teachers.

item.title: More Americans are going bankrupt. What does that mean?
item.description: Bankruptcy rates rose about 48% from 2022 to 2025, though still below pre-pandemic levels.

item.title: New AI art museum treats machines as collaborators
item.description: Artist Refik Anadol explores reality with Dataland, an immersive AI art museum in Los Angeles, and other projects.
